title: Normalized solutions to an exponential growth Choquard equation driven by mixed local-nonlocal operator in $\mathbb{R}^2$
summary: In this paper, we study the existence of normalized solutions to the mixed nonlinear Choquard equation with exponential growth \begin{equation} \left\{ \mathcal{L}u+λu = Λ(I_α*F(u))f(u) \text{ in }\mathbb{R}^{2}; \;\; \int_{\mathbb{R}^{2}}|u|^{2}\,dx = a^{2}, \right. \end{equation} where $\mathcal{L}=-Δ+(-Δ)^s$, $0 0$, $I_α$ is the Riesz potential of order $α\in(0,2)$, $Λ>0$, and $λ\in\mathbb{R}$ arises as a Lagrange multiplier. The nonlinearity has critical exponential growth in the sense of the Trudinger-Moser inequality. Using variational methods, the associated Pohožaev manifold, and…
